thermal_source.deployable_receiver_ceiling: Existing modeled volume-mean cell temperature can support a explicitly declared simulated thermometer port; it does not supply physical surface metrology. Correct receiver meaning and fair competitor access must be frozen before use.

thermal_source.heat_transfer_variants: Existing action words support ambient +0.5 K and initial-temperature preparation strata. No empirical thermal-contact coefficient distribution or aging mechanism is supplied.
thermal_source.surface_receiver: Surface temperature [K] equals Ambient temperature [K] in default surface submodel; not independent measured cell-surface temperature. Lumped cell temperature is one spatially broadcast volume-mean state.
thermal_source.two_temperature_option: Installed surface=lumped adds Casing heat capacity [J.K-1] and Environment thermal resistance [K.W-1]; neither is present in Chen2020 or inspected ORegan2022. No justified values added.
